series.name: Darkthorn Academy
series.hook: If Harry Potter lived in Middle Earth and had to loot dungeons to pay his school fees.
series.pitch: When Jack's grandfather is murdered, his dying words make Jack promise to attend Darkthorn Academy. Surviving it means making alliances, learning to harness magic, and facing enemies both living and dead. Nine books of dungeons, dragons, misfit friends and an empire that wants them gone.
series.readers_like: Readers of Quest Academy, Iron Prince and Mage Errant
series.landing_headline: A murdered grandfather. A dying promise. A school that eats first-years alive.
landing_bullets: A slightly overpowered hero who still has to earn every level
A dragon companion and a team of misfits worth rooting for
Dungeons, loot and mana techniques inspired by Skyrim, Diablo 2 and Fallout
Nine books, complete series — no waiting on cliffhangers

series.name: New Realm Online
series.hook: Leveling, dungeons, crafting, kingdom building, and terrifying killer bunnies.
series.pitch: Ryan Rosa has had a run of bad luck. Then he re-rolls into New Realm Online and starts building something special: a guild, a town, and eventually an empire. Classic LitRPG with stats you can follow, a cast you'll want at your table, and an audiobook series narrated by MacLeod Andrews.
series.readers_like: Readers of Life Reset, Dungeon Crawler Carl and He Who Fights with Monsters
series.landing_headline: Bad luck in real life. A fresh roll in the New Realm.
landing_bullets: Real LitRPG progression: levels, skills, crafting, dungeon loot
From one broke player to a guild, a town, and an empire
A snarky, loyal cast readers keep coming back for
Six books complete, plus audio from Podium narrated by MacLeod Andrews

series.name: Stoneblood Saga
series.hook: They tried to hide him. They tried to protect him. Nathan Stoneblood was never going to stay hidden.
series.pitch: A boy raised in a quiet village, a bloodline the powerful would kill to control, and a kingdom sliding toward war. Nathan Stoneblood gathers friends, masters magic he was never meant to have, and builds Elderwood from a refuge into a power. Eight books of classic sword-and-sorcery with a progression backbone.
series.readers_like: Readers of Riyria, The Wandering Inn (without the word count) and Cradle
series.landing_headline: Hidden from the world. Hunted by a kingdom. Stronger every chapter.
landing_bullets: A hero who grows from village boy to the power behind Elderwood
Friends, mentors and enemies who matter across all eight books
Magic learned the hard way, with real costs
Complete series, plus the free prequel novella Soron's Quest
